summary: The test file is syntactically correct and uses Playwright APIs properly, but the test assertion is weak and the test title does not include the mapped testCaseId 'TC-001'. The selector for product cards is missing, and there is no assertive verification that product cards are displayed. There is also a hardcoded base URL which could affect reusability and maintainability.

issues.description: The test includes a comment to verify product cards but lacks actual assertions validating their presence or content.
issues.recommendation: Add explicit assertions to verify the visibility and correctness of product cards to strengthen test reliability.

issues.description: The test title 'Display of Product Cards on Home Page' does not include the associated testCaseId 'TC-001'.
issues.recommendation: Incorporate the testCaseId into the test title for traceability, e.g., 'TC-001 - Display of Product Cards on Home Page'.

issues.description: No locator or selector is defined to specifically reference product cards on the page.
issues.recommendation: Define and use a precise selector for product cards to enable robust and clear assertions.

issues.description: The base URL is hardcoded which may reduce flexibility if environments change.
issues.recommendation: Use environment variables or configuration files to handle URLs for better reusability.

recommendations: Include testCaseId in test titles to improve traceability of tests against requirements.
Implement concrete assertions for product card visibility and content.
Consider improving selector specificity for product cards to avoid fragile tests.
Use environment configurations for base URLs to enhance maintainability.
